Notes
Full-Time and Part-Time Spa Therapists

Exciting opportunities have arisen for qualified Therapists to join our professional wellness and holistic Therapist Team at Brightlife Spa.

As we prepare to open our new Spa Garden and welcome more guests, we are expanding our team and are seeking both full-time and part-time therapists who share our commitment to exceptional treatments, outstanding guest care and holistic well-being.

Our Spa offers a range of indulgent treatments and wellness facilities within a serene and tranquil setting. Our therapies take a holistic approach, focusing on each guest as an individual and supporting their overall physical, mental and emotional well-being. We aim to provide every guest with a deeply relaxing, personalised and memorable experience.

The Role
As a Spa Therapist, you will play an important role in delivering exceptional treatments and ensuring the comfort and well-being of our guests throughout their visit.
Your responsibilities will include:
Performing a variety of spa treatments, including massage, facials, body treatments and other holistic wellness therapies.
Assessing each guest’s individual needs and tailoring treatments accordingly.
Providing knowledgeable and appropriate treatment and aftercare recommendations.
Delivering consistently high standards of guest care and professionalism.
Maintaining excellent standards of hygiene, cleanliness and presentation within treatment rooms and communal areas.
Working collaboratively with other members of the spa team to create a harmonious and efficient working environment.

Full training will be provided in our complete range of treatments and treatment protocols.

Qualifications and Attributes
Applicants should:
Hold an NVQ Level 3 qualification, or equivalent, in beauty therapy and massage.
Have excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
Demonstrate a genuine interest in holistic therapies, wellness and guest care.
Be able to work confidently both independently and as part of a team.
Have a positive, friendly and professional manner.
Be reliable, well-presented and committed to maintaining high standards.

What We Offer
Full in-house training in our treatment range and protocols.
Full uniform.
Competitive rates of pay.
A beautiful and supportive working environment.
The opportunity to become part of an established spa as it enters an exciting period of growth.

Both full-time and part-time positions are available. Working hours will include a combination of daytime, evening and weekend shifts.

How to Apply
To apply, please email your CV and a covering letter outlining your relevant qualifications and experience to julie.watson@brightlife.com.

Job Summary: 

A warm and welcoming family is seeking an experienced Housekeeper to join them on the beautiful Isle of Man, an area celebrated for its safety, stunning natural surroundings, and excellent quality of life.

This is the family’s full-time residence, set within extensive grounds and supported by an established outdoor team. The household is busy, friendly, and relaxed, with five children aged 6–17. The role will primarily focus on the younger three children, who split their time between 2 homes. 

Mum is very hands-on and involved in the children’s daily lives. They are looking for a positive, organised, and energetic Housekeeper who genuinely enjoys working with school-age children and can become a supportive, consistent presence in the family.

You will work alongside a friendly and experienced estate team, who will guide you through household systems and routines. This is a collaborative, well-structured, and welcoming environment, ideal for someone who thrives as part of a family team.
 

Job specification:

Housekeeping to a high standard
School runs pick-ups and drop-off and taking the children to different after school events
Supporting morning and after-school routines
Cooking for the children and occasionally the family (simple, family-style meals – not formal cooking) and preparing snacks
Ad hoc childcare during school holidays and evenings
Helping to keep children’s bedrooms, play areas and family spaces organised
Laundry management, general weekly and daily shops. 
Dog care and pet sitting

Candidate specification:

roven experience Housekeeper in a private household
Confident caring for multiple school-age children
A driver is required with a full clean driving licence – car provided for work and personal time
Warm, calm and structured approach
Energetic and organised with good initiative
Happy working within a team environment
Discreet and professional
Excellent, checkable references required
Must be pet friendly and enjoy working in homes with dogs

Enhanced DBS check required at offer stage & and a current First Aid Certificate
Working Days & hours: Five days per week, including weekends on two weeks of the month, 40 hours a week  

Please apply by sending your CV and covering letter to - enquiries@bramden.com

WORKS MANAGER – CIVILS & BUILDING

CCJ Group Limited is a growing and ambitious construction and civil engineering company delivering a wide range of projects as Principal Contractor across the Isle of Man, including Building Projects, Civil Engineering, Drainage, Demolition, Earthworks, Infrastructure, Utilities, and Refurbishment Projects.
We are looking for an experienced and driven Works Manager with a strong background across both civils and building projects to join our senior team.
This is not a desk-only management role. We are looking for someone practical, experienced, and confident — someone who understands construction from the ground up and can lead teams, organise operations, maintain standards, and help drive the business forward.
The ideal candidate will:
Have strong experience within the construction industry.
Come from either a trades, engineering, plant, or machinery background.
Be confident managing men, subcontractors, and site operations.
Understand civils, drainage, earthworks, foundations, and general building works.
Be highly organised and capable of managing multiple live operations.
Be driven, motivated, and capable of working within a fast-paced environment.
Be safety-focused, quality-focused, and commercially aware.
Lead by example and maintain high standards across the business.
Work closely with senior management to support long-term business growth.
Help build, develop, and strengthen teams within an increasingly challenging labour market.
CCJ operates its own fleet of machinery, wagons, quarry operations, tools, and labour force, so we need someone who can organise practical operations efficiently while maintaining professionalism and control throughout delivery.
This is a long-term opportunity for the right person, with:
Company vehicle/pick-up.
Competitive salary package.
Paid holidays.
Long-term progression into senior management.
Performance-based uplift opportunities.
The chance to become a key part of a growing and respected local business.
The position is open to both on-island and off-island applicants. Off-island candidates must already hold a valid visa and legal right to work within the UK and the Isle of Man.
We are looking for someone who wants responsibility, takes pride in their work, and wants to help build something long-term.
To apply or enquire confidentially, please contact CCJ Group Limited directly.
Derek Clarkson, CCJ Group Limited, Managing Director Tel: 01624 670950  or Email derek.clarkson@ccjgroup.co.uk

Notes
Hartford Homes is seeking an experienced Quantity Surveyor to join our award-winning team and help uphold our unrivalled reputation for building exceptional quality homes across the Isle of Man. This is a key full-time role within the business, with responsibility for the commercial management of residential developments from inception through to completion.

The successful candidate will be responsible for managing project budgets, cost plans, forecasts and cash flow, while preparing valuations, variations and final accounts. They will procure and manage subcontractor packages, monitor costs, identify commercial risks and opportunities, and produce accurate monthly commercial reports and cost reconciliations. The role also involves managing contractual matters, maintaining comprehensive commercial records, and working closely with site teams to support the successful delivery of projects. Regular liaison with subcontractors, suppliers and consultants will be essential to ensure effective communication and collaboration throughout each development.

Applicants should have proven experience as a Quantity Surveyor within the construction or housebuilding industry, supported by strong commercial awareness and cost management skills. Experience in subcontractor procurement and account management, together with a sound understanding of construction contracts and contractual procedures, is essential. The ideal candidate will possess excellent communication and relationship-building skills, enabling them to work effectively with both site and office teams. They will be organised, proactive and capable of managing multiple priorities, while also having the confidence to communicate tactfully and challenge constructively when required. Competence in Microsoft Excel, a full driving licence, and a commitment to maintaining and fostering strong teamwork are also key requirements for this role.

TO APPLY: Please send your CV and cover letter by email jobs@hartford.im or post Hartford Homes, Middle River, Douglas, IM2 1AL.

The successful candidate will be responsible for managing project budgets, cost plans, forecasts and cash flow, while preparing valuations, variations and final accounts. They will procure and manage subcontractor packages, monitor costs, identify commercial risks and opportunities, and produce accurate monthly commercial reports and cost reconciliations. The role also involves managing contractual matters, maintaining comprehensive commercial records, and working closely with site teams to support the successful delivery of projects. Regular liaison with subcontractors, suppliers and consultants will be essential to ensure effective communication and collaboration throughout each development.

Applicants should have proven experience as a Quantity Surveyor within the construction or housebuilding industry, supported by strong commercial awareness and cost management skills. Experience in subcontractor procurement and account management, together with a sound understanding of construction contracts and contractual procedures, is essential. The ideal candidate will possess excellent communication and relationship-building skills, enabling them to work effectively with both site and office teams. They will be organised, proactive and capable of managing multiple priorities, while also having the confidence to communicate tactfully and challenge constructively when required. Competence in Microsoft Excel, a full driving licence, and a commitment to maintaining and fostering strong teamwork are also key requirements for this role.

TO APPLY: Please send your CV and cover letter by email jobs@hartford.im or post Hartford Homes, Middle River, Douglas, IM2 1AL.

Notes
Quantity Surveyor – Building & Civil Engineering.
Location: Isle of Man.

CCJ Group Limited is seeking an experienced and motivated Quantity Surveyor to support the delivery of building and civil engineering projects across our expanding portfolio.

This is a key position within the business, working closely with the Managing Director and senior management team on a daily basis. The role offers genuine opportunity for progression into senior management as the company continues to grow.

The Role:
The successful candidate will be responsible for the commercial management of projects from inception through to completion, as well as contributing to the company’s estimating and tendering activities. You will work collaboratively with site and contracts teams, taking a hands-on and proactive approach across both pre-construction and delivery phases.

Key Responsibilities:

Commercial management of building and civil engineering projects.
Cost planning, procurement, and subcontractor management.
Preparation and agreement of valuations, variations, and final accounts.
Contract administration under JCT and NEC forms of contract.
Preparation of estimates, tenders, and bid submissions.
Reviewing drawings, specifications, and pricing project risks and oppotunities.
Supporting project teams with practical and commercial problem solving.
Developing and maintaining strong client relationships.

About You:

Driven and proactive with a strong work ethic.
Highly detail-oriented with sound commercial awareness.
Experience in both civil engineering and building projects.
Proven experience in estimating and tendering.
Good working knowledge of JCT and NEC contracts.
Practical, solutions-focused, and confident in problem solving.
A strong communicator who works well within a team environment.
Ambitious and keen to progress within a growing business.

Chartered status is not essential; the right attitude, experience, and capability are key.

What We Offer:

Competitive salary.
Performance-related bonus.
Company vehicle and fuel card.
Phone allowance.
Paid holidays.
Clear career progression into senior management.
A supportive, team-focused working environment.

Additional Information:
This role is based on the Isle of Man. Applicants must have the right to work in the UK, as visa sponsorship is not available.

For enquiries or to apply, please contact:
Derek Clarkson
Email: derek.clarkson@ccjgroup.co.uk
Telephone: 01624 670950

Enforce the Laws of the Game:
Apply the IFAB Laws of the Game fairly, consistently, and impartially throughout the match.

Protect players by penalising dangerous play, managing physical contact, and stopping play for injuries when required.

Control and Manage the Match:
Maintain discipline, manage tempo, and deal with misconduct using cautions (yellow cards) and send-offs (red cards).

Make Accurate Decisions:
Judge fouls, offsides (where applicable), restarts, goals, and infringements in real time.

Communicate effectively with assistant referees, fourth officials, and VAR (if used).

Complete match reports, including disciplinary actions, injuries, and incidents, accurately and on time.

Maintain fitness, knowledge of law changes, neutrality, and a high standard of behaviour on and off the pitch.

About this Opportunity
As a Client Delivery Associate, you will provide exceptional service to our International Private Banking Clients. You will be responsible for managing client cases and ensuring compliance with regulatory standards through ongoing due diligence (ODD) and Know Your Customer (KYC) processes. This role demands a proactive approach to client service and meticulous attention to detail.

Why Lloyds Banking Group
We’re on an exciting journey and there couldn’t be a better time to join us. The investments we’re making in our people, data, and technology are leading to innovative projects, fresh possibilities, and countless new ways for our people to work, learn, and thrive.

What you’ll need
You’ll need to be organised and manage your time effectively to ensure a balanced approach, supporting delivery of business area objectives.
You need to be honest, conscientious, and genuine, caring about helping customers.
You’ll be enthusiastic with the desire to deliver great service and be a team player that can work closely with colleagues.
An ability to quickly build relationships; to understand and meet your customer’s needs through our diverse range of services.
And any experience of these would be really useful.
Banking or business experience where you've dealt with customers previously.
Customer Service & Quality are key.

About working for us
Our focus is to ensure we're inclusive every day, building an organisation that reflects modern society and celebrates diversity in all its forms. We want our people to feel that they belong and can be their best, regardless of background, identity, or culture. We were one of the first major organisations to set goals on diversity in senior roles, create a menopause health package, and a dedicated Working with Cancer initiative. And it’s why we especially welcome applications from under-represented groups. We’re disability confident. So if you’d like reasonable adjustments to be made to our recruitment processes, just let us know.

We also offer a wide-ranging benefits package, which includes:
A generous pension contribution of up to 15%.
An annual performance-related bonus.
Share schemes including free shares.
Benefits you can adapt to your lifestyle, such as discounted shopping.
22 days’ holiday, with bank holidays on top.
A range of wellbeing initiatives and generous parental leave policies.

If you’re excited by the thought of becoming part of our team, get in touch via our Careers website https://lbg.wd3.myworkdayjobs.com/LBG_Careers/job/Douglas-Villiers-House/Client-Delivery-Associate---Isle-of-Man_161158-1

Key responsibilities include leading the Biology curriculum, monitoring student progress, promoting enrichment opportunities and contributing to the wider life of the school.

PROJECT ENGINEERING OFFICER
Grade: SO2 (SCP 30 – 36) £46,764 - £54,855

City Council is seeking an experienced Projects Engineering Officer to join the Projects Team within the Environment & Regeneration Department.  Reporting to the Head of Electrical Services & Projects, you will project manage the development and delivery of a wide range of engineering and construction projects that improve the City’s environment, support Council priorities and enhance services for residents, businesses and visitors.  This is an opportunity to shape the City’s environment through varied and impactful projects.  

You will need a degree, HND/HNC or equivalent in a building related subject, with experience in construction or civil engineering.  You should also have a strong knowledge of CDM, health and safety regulations, building construction and maintenance.  Knowledge of NEC and ICC/JCT contracts is essential as well as demonstrable experience designing and delivering engineering schemes, with contract preparation and management experience.  An accredited AutoCAD qualification, ability to collect and analyse data, control budgets and report on project performance is also required.  You must be an effective communicator, with organisational and time management skills with high attention to detail.  A full valid driving licence is necessary.  

To apply or find out more information, please visit our Job Train portal via the Council’s website.  For an informal chat about the role please contact Andy Butterworth, Head of Electrical Services & Projects, abutterworth@douglas.gov.im.  Alternatively, you can contact the Human Resources Section on (696455).

Swagelok Ltd

Tool Maker (Twilight Shift)

We are Hiring!

We are looking for an experienced Tool Maker on our twilight shift

Twilight shift (11 am – 21.00 pm working Monday to Thursday)

Toolmaker (Manual Machining & Tool Regrinding)

We are seeking a skilled and self-motivated Toolmaker with a strong background in manual machining and tool reconditioning. This role is focused on precision work using manual lathes and milling machines, alongside surface grinding, tool regrinding, and heat treatment processes.

The successful candidate will demonstrate a high level of craftsmanship and the ability to interpret engineering drawings accurately, while engaging proactively with internal customers to deliver practical, high-quality solutions.

Key Responsibilities:

Manufacture, modify, and repair tooling using manual lathes, milling machines, and grinders.
Independently, re-grind a wide range of cutting tools, including drills, reamers, and similar end-working tools, ensuring accuracy and timely turnaround.
Perform heat treatment processes as required to support tooling performance and longevity.
Carry out maintenance repairs to jigs, make new fixtures, gauges, and other tooling.
Set up and operate all relevant machine tools and equipment safely and efficiently.
Read and interpret technical drawings and specifications with a high degree of accuracy.
Apply problem-solving skills to identify and resolve non-routine tooling or machining issues.
Work collaboratively with customers and colleagues to develop practical and cost-effective solutions.
Skills & Experience

Strong hands-on experience in traditional toolmaking, with a focus on manual machining processes.
Proven ability to re-grind and restore a variety of cutting tools independently.
Competence in surface grinding and heat treatment techniques.
Excellent understanding of engineering drawings, tolerances, and materials.
Ability to work with minimal supervision while maintaining high standards.
Effective communication skills and a customer-focused mindset.
Additional Requirements

Adheres to all plant regulatory and safety requirements.
Supports the company operating plan and aligns with Swagelok’s mission, vision, and values.
About You

This opportunity is ideal for a dedicated professional who takes pride in their work, thrives in a team environment, and consistently delivers high standards in customer service, quality, and cost-effectiveness.

To apply please visit our recruitment portal at http://iomjobs.swagelok.com

Maintenance Housekeeper.
Swagelok is a global engineering company, manufacturing a wide range of high-quality components to a world market, which offers a competitive benefits package for all employees.
Due to continued growth in our Isle of Man site, we are looking for a maintenance housekeeper to join our facilities and maintenance department.
The successful candidates will be responsible for following the company’s general housekeeping and safety practices & policies. They will also be required to independently identify and perform general cleaning for their areas of responsibility.
Additional tasks include supporting our maintenance technicians with general upkeep of our facility including CNC machining centres, assisting with machine moves and installation of new equipment.
As a customer facing site, we require the successful candidate to show close attention to detail, to take pride in their work and ensure a high standard is maintained in all aspects of their roll.
It is preferred that the applicant; holds a counterbalance forklift licence, has experience with food & hygiene in the workplace and is manual handling trained.

Notes
Our client is seeking an experienced and qualified finance leader to take full ownership of their global Accounting & Control function. Reporting directly to the CFO, this is a senior, high-impact role within a dynamic multinational trading group with offices across Europe, Africa, and Latin America. The successful candidate will have already operated at a senior level within a complex multinational environment and will bring a demonstrable track record of leading accounting functions, managing audit relationships, and driving compliance standards across multiple entities. The role carries one direct report and functional oversight responsibility for all regional accounting, control, and compliance teams across the Group. Key Skills and Experience: ACA (Institute of Chartered Accountants in England & Wales), CA (SA) (South African Institute of Chartered Accountants), or CPA (US Certified Public Accountant) - these are the benchmark qualifications for this role and represent a near non-negotiable requirement. To oversee and manage the daily operations of onboarding operations teams, driving optimal performance and delivery of an 
exceptional onboarding experience for clients that embodies world-class operational standards.
Manage the onboarding process by ensuring the accurate capturing of transaction details to enable the generation of agreements and / or contracts and the preparation of guarantees within laid down procedures. Guide the accurate loading of agreements and / or contracts within turnaround time as well as validating the payment amounts to be processed by Payments team to ensure accuracy and no losses to SBG.
Identify, manage and control areas of risk. Communicate, enforce and provide input to procedure, process, policy and risk documents to ensure proper controls are in place to mitigate risk and optimise regulatory compliance. Mitigate risk and Financial loses through vetting of client onboarding executed by Onboarding teams and validating the payment amounts to be processed.
Responsible for the overall performance, productivity and quality of work of the team through managing and prioritising the work and guiding team members to achieve all targets and goals. Manage and guide the team in all Onboarding functions, ensuring customer service levels SLA’s are met and financial losses and risks mitigated.
Understand and assess the risks associated with Out of SLA functions and maintain an effective system of control to ensure effective management of available resources.
Manage the vetting and verification of clients process to ensure clients are cleared to be onboarded and transacting with SBG products.

We are seeking an experienced Trust Manager to join our Client Services team. Reporting to the Client Director, you will be responsible for managing a portfolio of trust and company structures, delivering exceptional client service while ensuring the highest standards of governance, compliance, and fiduciary administration.
Key Responsibilities:
Manage the day-to-day administration of trust and company structures; build and maintain strong relationships with clients, intermediaries, and professional advisors; prepare and review governance documentation, including minutes, resolutions, and statutory filings; oversee client records, bookkeeping, financial administration, and coordination of accounts and tax reporting; ensure compliance with AML/CFT, sanctions, regulatory, and corporate governance requirements, and internal procedures; support client onboarding, business retention, and continuous improvement initiatives; manage a small team of client-facing staff members and provide coaching and technical guidance to junior team members.

Professionally qualified (STEP, CGI/ICSA, ACA, ACCA or equivalent); proven experience in trust and company services within a regulated TCSP/fiduciary environment, with strong knowledge of corporate governance, and regulatory requirements; excellent organisational, communication, and stakeholder management skills, strong risk awareness, attention to detail, and problem-solving ability; experience reviewing financial information and maintaining high-quality client records.
Why Join Us?
This is an excellent opportunity to take ownership of a varied portfolio, manage a collaborative team, and contribute to the delivery of high-quality fiduciary services in a professional and client-focused environment. We offer a competitive salary and benefits package, and strong continuing professional development support. To apply for this position, please send a current CV and a short cover email to hr@abacustrustgroup.com. Closing date for applications is Friday 7th August 2026.

Providing technical accounting leadership, ensure IFRS compliance and high-quality financial reporting, and drive continuous improvement across financial processes and controls.

Monitor departmental budgets and operating expenses, working closely with stakeholders across the business.

Strong accounting / audit technical background.
Strong proficiency in MS Excel.
Ability to work within a team and independently, holding themselves accountable for meeting team and individual deadlines.
Ability to build and maintain relationships with management.
Strong communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.

Westwinds Offshore Services Ltd is an independent trust and corporate services provider offering a comprehensive range of services to local and international clients. We are looking for an experienced Accounts Assistant to join our friendly team and support the day-to-day bookkeeping and finance function across our trust and corporate services business. To apply for this role go visit our website: https://kpmg.peoplehr.net/Pages/JobBoard/Opening.aspx?v=a2e3dd19-68ff-4c01-83f6-7df3f9035592

The role: 
The Senior Digital Marketing Executive will provide support for the Markets and Marketing function as well as the wider CDs firm. The ideal candidate should be diligent and well-versed running social media campaign and assisting in maintaining and updating the Crown Dependencies website. The candidate should also be familiar with design software, such as Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop and InDesign. The person should have the ability to plan, execute and manage timelines excellently. The role will require communication to stakeholders at all levels.

Accountabilities:
Support the team with campaign production and execution where needed, from global thought leadership to local events.
Create emails to be distributed internally and externally.
General administration which might include helping event suppliers with invoices, managing the job tracker, managing data into our CRM system, manage email queries regarding events.
Assist with eMarketing, including use of our CRM system and sending emails externally.
Maintain and update the local Crown Dependencies website. This includes liaising with other departments to ensure that the information included is accurate to the services they provide.
Act as creative lead for the marketing team – includes overseeing design work done by other members of the team and ensure brand guideline compliance.
Creating and scheduling social media content for LinkedIn, Facebook and Instagram posts that are in line with our brand guidelines and in terms of imagery and tone of voice.
Develop and manage social media campaigns, both organic and paid.
Efficiently analyse the performance of both social media and the website to inform decision-making of future digital marketing activities.
Provide training to other departments within the firm to ensure brand compliance of documents that are sent to clients / external stakeholders.
Other marketing tasks may be included as the candidate becomes familiar with the working environment and team.

Candidate requirements:
Ideally hold CIM professional qualification or equivalent, or have studied some sort of marketing, and/ or 4-5yrs experience working in a marketing role.
Strong networking and presentation skills.
Excellent experience running digital marketing campaigns.
Previous experience with Adobe software is advantageous.
An ability to express views and ideas articulately, from both a written and oral perspective.
Confident and independent personal skills.
Ability to multi-task, prioritise workloads and meet agreed timeframes.

Notes
Location: Glasgow or Isle of Man Barclays Campus with hybrid working options? 
Working Hours: You’ll work across a 24/7 rotating shift pattern, covering a mix of weekday and weekend shifts including evenings, nights and occasional afternoons to support global client needs. 
About the Role: 
We’re growing our team to better support our global market clients, extending our service beyond core business hours to meet their everyday banking needs.  
Join us as a Customer Service Advisor and be part of this next phase of growth.  
In this role, you’ll deliver a great experience for our clients as their first point of contact.  You’ll support them with their everyday banking needs, building strong relationships, developing your skills and growing your knowledge in a fast-paced, client-focused environment.
To apply - 
https://barclays.wd3.myworkdayjobs.com/External_Career_Site_Barclays/job/Glasgow-Campus/Customer-Service-Advisor--24-7-shift-pattern_JR-0000117716

Shift Pattern: 

Rotation across day, evening and overnight shift, including a mix of weekdays and weekend working. 
Typical shift times range between 20:00 – 06:30 and 22:15 – 09:00, with some afternoon and evening shifts (14:00 – 23:45). 
Built on an 8-week rotational cycle to provide variety and fairness across shifts.

What You’ll Be Doing 

Delivering client service across telephony and written channels. 
Building, trusted relationships by understanding needs and responding with empathy and professionalism. 
Supporting clients with their banking products and services, offering solutions that meet their circumstances. 
Listening carefully to understand and provide clear, accurate, and timely support. 
Working collaboratively with colleagues to deliver a consistent, high?quality experience.
Following policies and processes to maintain a strong risk and control environment.

This is a key role within the Audit and Assurance practice, offering the opportunity to work closely with senior leadership, contribute to strategic client relationships, and help shape the future of the FS audit offering on the Isle of Man. Key Responsibilities: Lead and manage a diverse portfolio of Financial Services audit clients, ensuring high-quality audit delivery. Identify client needs and explore opportunities to provide additional value or services. Project manage audits from planning through to completion, ensuring efficient workflows and quality outcomes. Design and implement tailored audit plans that meet client requirements and comply with relevant standards. Supervise, support, and develop junior team members, maintaining high-quality standards throughout. Prepare and present business tenders to support the continued growth of the FS audit portfolio. Manage working capital, including timely billing, monitoring work in progress, and ensuring profitability. Prepare financial statements and related deliverables in accordance with applicable standards. Key Skills & Experience: Minimum of 5 years' experience in audit, ideally with exposure to financial services clients. Professionally qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA, or equivalent). Strong portfolio and client relationship management experience. Excellent technical audit knowledge, with up-to-date understanding of accounting and auditing standards. Commercially astute with an ability to identify growth opportunities and add value. Proficient at working independently, taking initiative, and managing multiple priorities. Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build rapport with clients and colleagues. Experience in a Big 4 environment is advantageous but not essential. 
 If you have the required skills please apply online at searchandselect.com quoting reference number: 16458

Quay Dental is seeking a newly qualified GDC-registered Dental Therapist to join our team from September 2026. We are a modern private dental clinic located in the heart of Douglas on the beautiful Isle of Man, committed to delivering exceptional patient care within a supportive and forward-thinking environment. This is an exciting opportunity for a highly motivated Clinician looking to further develop their skills, with mentorship from an experienced Principal Dentist who will provide ongoing guidance, training and support. The role is initially offered as a 12-month training position with the opportunity for a permanent role thereafter. As a Dental Therapist at Quay Dental, you will undertake the full scope of dental therapy within your competence, including intra-oral scanning, while providing hygiene and therapy treatments using the latest technology including air-polishing. Our vision is to provide a therapy-led approach to dental maintenance, with the Dental Therapist playing an integral role within the team. You will work closely alongside our Dentists and existing Therapist to provide maintenance and treatment appointments with full dental nurse support. There will also be the opportunity to undertake a Postgraduate Diploma programme to further enhance your clinical skills and knowledge. We offer a salary of £40,000 based on a four-day week, together with a bonus scheme, reimbursed GDC fees, up to six weeks holiday pro-rata including bank holidays, private healthcare insurance and postgraduate training support. Outside of work, you will enjoy the very best of coastal living on the scenic Isle of Man, with beaches, countryside, wildlife and excellent quality of life, alongside low crime, excellent schools and fantastic transport links to the UK. With a maximum upper tax bracket of just 21%, your earnings can go significantly further. To apply or arrange a confidential conversation, please contact careers@quaydental.co.uk

About Us:

Woodbourne Dental is a modern and well-established dental practice in Douglas, Isle of Man, committed to providing top-quality dental care in a friendly and professional environment. We are seeking a dedicated and organized Dental Nurse to join our team.

Job Purpose

To provide chairside support to dental professionals while delivering excellent patient care and progressing towards a recognized dental nursing qualification.

Key Responsibilities

Assist the dentist during a variety of treatments, including routine check-ups, fillings, and surgical procedures.
Set up and clean down surgeries before and after each patient in accordance with infection prevention and control protocols.
Ensure all equipment is sterilized and safe for use, following infection control procedures.
Prepare and maintain the clinical environment, including instruments and materials.
Perform intraoral scanning under supervision, aiding with digital impressions and workflow for orthodontic, restorative, or cosmetic treatments.
Deliver excellent patient care and support, ensuring a comfortable and welcoming experience.
Accurately record patient details, procedures, and notes as directed by the dentist, including maintaining logbooks.
Ensure that patient confidentiality is always maintained.
Adhere to all CQC, GDPR, and health and safety guidelines.
Attend off-site or online training as part of the dental nurse qualification.
Participate in the wider team effort, including reception duties or assisting other nurses and clinicians as needed.
Stay updated with current dental best practices and maintain CPD in line with GDC requirements (qualified nurses) or training program guidelines (trainees).
Essential Requirements:

A genuine interest in dental healthcare and patient welfare.
Good communication and interpersonal skills.
Willingness to enrol in and complete an accredited dental nursing qualification.
Professional appearance and attitude.
Ability to follow instructions and work under pressure.
Must be a resident on IOM or have a valid working permit
Desirable but not essential:

Previous experience in a healthcare or customer service role.
Knowledge of basic dental terminology.
Familiarity with dental software (e.g. SOE, R4) is a plus.

Notes
Join a brilliant team on the Isle of Man, committed to supporting autistic people to live as independently as possible and to be part of their local community. Autism Initiatives work positively alongside people with autism, providing specialist services that are tailored to each individual.

We are seeking friendly Support Workers to join us at our Residential services. We have a number of houses located in Central and Northern parts of the Island within easy reach of local bus routes.

We are looking for someone who is enthusiastic and will enjoy joining a team that encourages people with autism to enjoy an active lifestyle. Community activities could include swimming, accessing walking groups or trips to the cinema or even camping trips and gorge walking. Support Workers promote health and well-being and support individuals to maintain their home. The support we deliver is flexible and unique to each individual, building on their strengths and driven by their goals.

Experience is not essential, but a genuine desire to making a difference to the lives of people with autism, as well as a positive attitude is. This is truly a rewarding role, with the opportunity for you to develop your skills, knowledge and fulfil your career aspirations.

We particularly welcome applications from candidates who hold a manual driving licence.

For more information, or to apply, please visit jobs.autisminitiatives.org.

Notes
We're looking for a Pharmacist who sees this as far more than a dispensing role. This is an opportunity to lead an established team, help grow the business, and bring enthusiasm, creativity and direction to a pharmacy that's ready to evolve. You'll play a key role in improving existing services, developing new clinical and private healthcare offerings, building relationships with local GP surgeries, care providers and surrounding communities, and making a genuine difference to patients who value and support their local pharmacist. The role includes delivering all NHS core and advanced services alongside Weight Management and Travel Vaccination clinics, with opportunities to introduce innovative private services, expand MDS provision, strengthen services for local nursing homes, and manage pharmacy services for the local prison. There is also exciting potential to help develop the pharmacy into a pilot site for Independent Prescribing, offering extended clinics that function almost like a local GP surgery. We're looking for an ambitious, proactive Pharmacist who is passionate about community healthcare, excited by service development and clinical innovation, and able to inspire a capable team while leading from the front. Whether you're newly qualified or experienced, if you see opportunities rather than simply completing tasks and want to demonstrate what modern community pharmacy can achieve, we'd love to hear from you.

CV and cover note should be emailed to jobs@karsonspharmacy.co.uk

Crossroads are looking for care practitioners who have the versatility to support people with care needs across a broad spectrum either in a group setting, one to one out in the community or in client's own homes.
Qualifications and experience preferred but not strictly necessary as personality is key and training will be given.
Applicants should be able to drive and have access to their own car as clients can be based anywhere in the island.
Hours are dependent on the needs of the clients and can include early morning, evenings and weekends.
Guaranteed hours - part time and full time contracts are available.
The successful applicant will be required to do an enhanced DBS check, at their own expense, before employment can commence.

Notes
HOSPICE PHYSICIAN – (SPECIALITY DOCTOR)
Part time - 10 hours per week on a Limited Term Appointment for 12 months
Includes possibly ad hoc on call cover and weekend working

We are looking for a Physician to join our small caring and professional team to provide day to day clinical care to ensure excellent end of life care is delivered to our patients. You will work closely with our Medical Director and will assist with overnight on call provision when the Medical Director is unable. Some weekend work may also be included.

Using your experience as a medical practitioner, your excellent communication skills and your ability to empathise with patients and the people that matter to them, you will be able to deliver high quality care that is flexible and responsive to our patient’s needs.

Hospice has a passion for continuous improvement, and, as part of our team, you will ensure that we continue to deliver the best quality care whilst working collaboratively with and valuing the contribution of all team members. 

Interested in finding out more? 
For an informal discussion please contact:
The People and Culture team on 01624 647486 / 01624 647451 or via email to HR@hospice.org.im We can then arrange a call back from Justine Needham, Medical Director at a convenient time
To apply please refer to the Job Description and download an Application Form for completion and return along with your CV and covering letter to: The People and Culture Team, Hospice Isle of Man, Strang, Braddan, IM4 4RP or email to: hr@hospice.org.im

We are looking to recruit experienced health care assistants to join our team at Silverdale Care Home. 
As a Health Care Assistant your role is to provide dignified and individualised support to older people who may require extra assistance. You will work as part of an established team providing support to our residents with day to day care. You will need to be a kind, caring individual who likes to provide care and support helping others. Principal Duties Include: To assist in providing highest standards of personal care and attention for the residents. To assist with personal hygiene as per care plan. Providing support at mealtimes, helping to serve meals, prepare tables. Promote independence and wellbeing of our residents. To be polite and helpful at all times i.e. appropriate conduct and attitude towards the residents, visitors and colleagues at all times.
We are offering day and night shifts (you will need to advise if you have a preference). This role is physically demanding but also provides the opportunity to learn and grow and ensure that our residents are provided with a high standard of person-centred care. A full induction programme will be provided upon commencement of employment. 
We provide an ongoing training programme throughout each year to promote professional development.
We will require an enhanced DBS check.  Uniform is provided. If you are interested in applying for this position, please contact Michelle on email office@silverdalecare.com to request the application form.

Community Support Workers to join our lovely and 
dedicated team to provide high quality domiciliary care

compassionate, respectful, honest and caring support 
workers with good communication and 
interpersonal skills. As a support worker you will support

and mileage pay on top of hourly rate. You will always 
have the support of management team 24/7. At LV we

achieve more. We ensure they have the freedom and 
resources to help them make a difference in the care

Notes
We are looking for an experienced, enthusiastic and approachable Catering Manager to join our team at The Milntown Estate and take responsibility for the day-to-day running and development of our front-of-house catering operation.
Our café is an important part of Milntown and is often the first point of contact for people visiting the Estate. We want someone who can lead and support our existing team, maintain the friendly and welcoming atmosphere, and help us continue to improve and grow the business.
The role will involve managing and supporting the front-of-house team, preparing rotas and ensuring appropriate staffing levels, maintaining excellent customer service, overseeing stock and ordering, managing costs and budgets, and looking for opportunities to increase sales and develop what we offer.
Milntown is also a busy events venue, so you will work alongside our Events & Marketing Manager and Head Chef to help plan and deliver the catering side of weddings, functions, wakes and other events held across the Estate.
Maintaining high standards will be an important part of the role. This includes food hygiene, health and safety, cleaning schedules and other relevant procedures and regulations, working together with the Head Chef where responsibilities are shared across the operation.
This is very much a hands-on role. We are looking for someone who enjoys being part of the team and is happy to get involved when needed, particularly during busy services, functions and events.
For a full recruitment pack and detailed job description, or if you would like to find out more about the role, please contact General Manager Adam Quayle at estateoffice@milntown.org.

R & B Catering Ltd is seeking an experienced Takeaway Manager to oversee the daily operations of our busy takeaway. The role involves managing kitchen and takeaway operations, supervising and supporting staff, preparing rotas, ordering stock and maintaining inventory levels, ensuring compliance with food hygiene and health and safety regulations, training and performance management, maintaining till and cash records, delivering excellent customer service, handling customer enquiries and complaints professionally, and liaising with suppliers and relevant local authorities where required.

Applicants should have previous experience in a restaurant or takeaway management role, strong leadership and organisational skills, a good understanding of food hygiene and health and safety requirements, and the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment while maintaining high standards of customer service.

This is a full-time position (40 hours per week) with a salary of £26,000–£28,000 per annum, depending on experience. Flexibility is essential, as the successful candidate will be required to work evenings, weekends, late nights, public holidays, and other peak trading periods. Availability to work throughout the Isle of Man TT, Manx Grand Prix, Christmas, Easter, and other exceptionally busy periods is an essential requirement of the role, as is the ability to confidently manage customer interactions during busy service hours.

Welcoming guests with genuine warmth and a positive attitude.

A supportive, welcoming team.

Varied shifts across café service, evening service, and events.

Opportunities to grow as the resort continues to expand.

A beautiful working environment overlooking the lakes.

Head Chef – Terminus Tavern
Lead Our Kitchen. Shape Our Food. Inspire Our Team.

The Terminus Tavern is seeking an experienced and ambitious Head Chef to lead our kitchen and drive our food offer forward. This is an opportunity to take ownership of a busy food-led operation, delivering exceptional standards whilst developing a talented team and contributing to the continued success of one of the Isle of Man's most established pub venues.

As Head Chef, you will be responsible for all aspects of kitchen performance, including food quality, team leadership, menu execution, stock control, profitability and compliance. Working closely with the General Manager and Operations Team, you will ensure every guest receives a consistently outstanding dining experience.

We're looking for a hands-on leader who is passionate about great food, thrives in a fast-paced environment and takes pride in building high-performing teams. You will bring strong culinary skills, sound commercial awareness and the ability to motivate and develop others while maintaining the highest standards of food safety and hygiene.

Previous experience as a Head Chef, Senior Sous Chef or Kitchen Manager within a quality pub, restaurant or hospitality environment is essential, along with a strong understanding of fresh food operations, kitchen management and team development.

In return, you'll have the opportunity to influence menus, support the growth of your team, and play a key role in shaping the future of food at the Terminus Tavern. This is an exciting role for someone who wants to make a genuine impact within a respected and growing hospitality business.

Apply here: https://careers.hb.im/job/head-chef-at-the-terminus-tavern-5973399?source=hb.im

The Claremont Full-Time.  
At The Claremont, we pride ourselves on delivering an exceptional dining experience for every guest. We're looking for a confident, hands-on F&B Supervisor to lead our front-of-house team, keep service running smoothly, and help maintain the high standards our guests expect.
ABOUT THE ROLE
As F&B Supervisor, you'll oversee daily restaurant operations, ensure high standards of food quality and customer care, and lead a team delivering excellent service. You'll also be expected to fulfil the duties of a Food & Beverage Assistant, setting the standard for the team by example. You'll report to the Duty Manager / Operations Manager.
WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING
Supervising and coordinating daily restaurant operations, ensuring the team performs effectively.
Maintaining high standards of food quality, hygiene, and customer service.
Assisting with training and scheduling front-of-house F&B staff.
Monitoring inventory levels and assisting with ordering supplies.
Handling guest enquiries, complaints, and feedback professionally, in person, by phone, and by email.
Managing the booking system, including table allocations, deposits, and pre-orders.
Liaising with the kitchen team on dietary requirements and special requests.
Supporting Conference & Events planning, from enquiries through to on-the-day operations.
Ensuring compliance with food hygiene, health & safety, and risk assessment requirements.
Assisting with financial management, including monitoring wastage and breakages.
WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR
Previous experience in a food & beverage or front-of-house supervisory role.
A natural leader who motivates and supports a team.
Excellent customer service skills with a calm, professional manner.
Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.
Good working knowledge of food hygiene and health & safety practices.
A flexible, hands-on approach and willingness to work as part of the team.
WHY JOIN THE CLAREMONT
A supportive, close-knit team environment.
Opportunities for training and career development.
Uniform provided.
The chance to help shape an exceptional guest dining experience.

For more details and to apply contact recruitment@sleepwellhotels.com

At The Claremont, we pride ourselves on delivering an exceptional dining experience for every guest. We're looking for a confident, hands-on F&B Supervisor to lead our front-of-house team, keep service running smoothly, and help maintain the high standards our guests expect.
ABOUT THE ROLE
As F&B Supervisor, you'll oversee daily restaurant operations, ensure high standards of food quality and customer care, and lead a team delivering excellent service. You'll also be expected to fulfil the duties of a Food & Beverage Assistant, setting the standard for the team by example. You'll report to the Duty Manager / Operations Manager.
WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING
Supervising and coordinating daily restaurant operations, ensuring the team performs effectively.
Maintaining high standards of food quality, hygiene, and customer service.
Assisting with training and scheduling front-of-house F&B staff.
Monitoring inventory levels and assisting with ordering supplies.
Handling guest enquiries, complaints, and feedback professionally, in person, by phone, and by email.
Managing the booking system, including table allocations, deposits, and pre-orders.
Liaising with the kitchen team on dietary requirements and special requests.
Supporting Conference & Events planning, from enquiries through to on-the-day operations.
Ensuring compliance with food hygiene, health & safety, and risk assessment requirements.
Assisting with financial management, including monitoring wastage and breakages.
WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR
Previous experience in a food & beverage or front-of-house supervisory role.
A natural leader who motivates and supports a team.
Excellent customer service skills with a calm, professional manner.
Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.
Good working knowledge of food hygiene and health & safety practices.
A flexible, hands-on approach and willingness to work as part of the team.
WHY JOIN THE CLAREMONT
A supportive, close-knit team environment.
Opportunities for training and career development.
Uniform provided.
The chance to help shape an exceptional guest dining experience.

Join a seafood?led kitchen on the Isle of Man’s west coast

The Boatyard is a busy, modern coastal restaurant on Peel harbour, known for fresh seafood, seasonal menus, and a warm, professional team culture. We’re looking for a talented Sous Chef to join our kitchen and help lead service with creativity, consistency, and pride.

The Role:
As Sous Chef, you’ll work closely with our Head Chef to deliver high?quality, seafood?focused dishes that celebrate local produce. You’ll take ownership of day?to?day kitchen operations, support junior chefs, and ensure every plate leaving the pass reflects our standards.

What We’re Looking For:
Strong experience in a professional kitchen, ideally with seafood, confidence running a section and leading service, a passion for fresh, local produce, good communication and leadership skills, high standards, attention to detail, and pride in your work, someone who thrives in a busy, supportive team environment.

Competitive pay based on experience, a supportive, friendly team and positive working culture, opportunities for progression and creative input, a beautiful coastal workplace with a strong local following.

If you’re a skilled chef who loves seafood, enjoys working with quality ingredients, and wants to be part of a respected harbour?side restaurant, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply with your CV and a short introduction why you would be ideal for this position, why include some photos of your food and tell us about your favourite dishes,  to fish@theboatyardpeel.com

The successful applicant would be responsible for planning, preparing, and cooking high-quality meals while maintaining food safety and hygiene standards. They ensure that every dish meets the establishment’s quality and presentation standards.

Key Responsibilities

* Prepare and cook food according to recipes and quality standards.
* Ensure compliance with food safety, sanitation, and hygiene regulations.
* Monitor food quality, taste, and presentation.
* Receive, and manage kitchen inventory and supplies.
* Maintain cleanliness and organization of the kitchen.
* Ensure kitchen equipment is used safely and report maintenance needs.
* Work efficiently during busy service periods.

Key Skills

Applicant must demonstrate excellent cooking and culinary techniques, show team player attitude to ensure the kitchen operates efficiently. Preferably highly organised, with the ability to manage their time effectively, multitask in a fast-paced environment, and perform well under pressure. Creativity is essential for developing innovative menus and preparing high-quality dishes, while a thorough understanding of food safety and hygiene standards ensures compliance with health regulations. Strong attention to detail helps maintain consistency in food quality and presentation, and effective communication and organizational skills enable the chef to work collaboratively with kitchen staff and deliver an exceptional dining experience.

Qualifications (Typical)

* Culinary arts qualification or equivalent experience.
* Experience in a professional kitchen.
* Food safety certification (where required).
* Knowledge of various cuisines and cooking techniques.

How to apply:
Contact Kris or Mike by email mail@welbeckhotel.com or drop in with CV.

Prepare and format data for upload into CRM and case management systems. Support data requirements linked to compensation activity. Work closely with operations, customer service and IT teams. Investigate and resolve data quality issues. Ensure data integrity for customer contact and payment processes. Key Skills & Experience: Strong hands on experience working with data in a banking or financial services environment. Experience with data extraction, transformation or integration work. Good understanding of databases, spreadsheets, data manipulation or ETL processes. Experience working with CRM or operational systems. Advantageous: Ability to work with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Strong attention to detail and ability to manage volume and deadlines.

We are looking for a Trainee IT & Print Engineer to join our team and develop a career within IT, print technology and technical services. This is a varied, hands-on role that offers the opportunity to learn from experienced professionals whilst gaining valuable technical skills and industry-recognised training.

No previous engineering experience is required. We are looking for someone with a positive attitude, a willingness to learn and a genuine interest in technology.

What you will be doing:

Preparing and configuring printers and other devices before customer installation.
Delivering and installing equipment across the Isle of Man.
Supporting toner and consumables management for customers.
Assisting with the preparation and deployment of laptops and Apple devices.
Receiving, checking and organising stock within the warehouse.
Supporting inventory control and stocktake activities.
Learning our service desk and ticket management systems.
Providing excellent customer service both on-site and over the phone.

Typical working hours are a 37.5-hour week Monday to Friday.

SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE REQUIRED:
A keen interest in IT and technology.
Good practical and problem-solving skills.
Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.
A customer-focused approach.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Ideally a full driving licence.

What we offer:

Full training and ongoing support.
Manufacturer training with leading technology providers.
Opportunity to attend specialist training courses in the UK.
Exposure to a wide range of IT and print technologies.
Genuine career progression into technical engineering roles.
A varied role where no two days are the same.

This role would suit a college leaver, someone looking to start a career in IT or engineering, or an individual with customer service or technical experience who is looking for a new challenge.

To bridge the gap between technical IT teams and business managers by transforming raw data into actionable intelligence, ensuring the organisation's data is accurate, secure and effectively managed to support business decision making. Key Skills &  Experience: Usually degree educated in IT, Computer Science or statistical methods, with relevant experience. Advanced proficiency in programming languages and database systems like SQL, Python, Oracle. Solid understanding of data modelling / warehousing concepts and modern enterprise data architecture principles. Analytical & Problem-Solving: Ability to evaluate integrity and interpret inconsistencies across large, complex datasets. Manage and develop a small, high performing data team, including mentoring, 1:1s and continuous improvement initiatives. Proven experience in a similar role. Experience analysing complex data, identifying trends, and providing actionable insights to support business decision-making. Experience collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders to understand data requirements and deliver effective solutions. High level of accuracy and attention to detail.
 For a full list of responsibilities and requirements or to apply for this great role, please visit the website at searchandselect.com, quoting the reference number:  16688

Notes
Phantom Ltd, the Isle of Man software studio behind PhantomTrace and our KYC AI platform, working closely with Crossleys Forensics (a forensic accounting firm in the UHY international network), is hiring a Software Engineer to build and own some of our software end to end, from a rough idea through to a running service that people rely on. You would work across backend, deployment, and the day-to-day of keeping things healthy, design systems that are simple to run and simple for the next person to read, and integrate with third-party services such as KYC providers and forensic data sources. We build with AI agents every day, Claude Code and tools like it are central to how we work, so this role sits right in the middle of that.

We are looking for someone with strong backend engineering, real cloud and deployment experience (you can put a service into production and look after it), and a solid grounding in system design and engineering principles. You should be genuinely fluent with agentic development, meaning you have built real things with coding agents and understand context management, skills and subagents, prompting, and orchestration, with a clear view of where they help and where they get in the way. Good API design and integration skills matter too. Useful extras include some frontend and UI sense, various programming languages, and application security, and any exposure to forensics, compliance, fraud, or eGaming is a bonus rather than a requirement. What matters most to us is how fast you learn and whether your judgment holds up when the agent is confidently wrong. This is a full-time role based on the Isle of Man, and you must already have the right to live and work here.

To apply, send your CV and a short note about something you have built to hello@phantomstudios.io

Our client seeks a Senior Test Analyst to join their team. Key Responsibilities: Designing and executing functional and regression tests. Collaborating with change teams (BA/PM), development, and the business, to align testing with business & project objectives. Identifying, planning and implementing the test approach across BAU and project workstreams. Monitoring estimates against actuals, escalating potential slippage and providing workable options for mitigation. Monitoring and reporting on test results, creating & maintaining reporting dashboards, and producing completion reports for stakeholder approval. Adhering to testing strategy, processes & procedures to facilitate governance. Maintaining accurate documentation and artefacts for audit and governance purposes Designing, maintaining re-useable regression tests following internal standards, supporting test execution where needed to ensure deadlines are achieved. Developing own knowledge of automation technology and practice, to facilitate a shift-left/automation first approach. Coordination & support of UAT/BVT testing activities. Performance management, training & and support of direct reports. Key Skills and Experience: Minimum 3 years of testing experience. Excellent understanding of testing principles, techniques and methodologies. Strong analytical & problem-solving skills, attention to detail and commitment to quality. ISTQB Foundation certificate in Software Testing. Experience of test automation is an advantage. Excellent communication, collaboration & leadership skills. Experience with using Gherkin syntax for test case design. Proven track record of delivering to tight deadlines. Experience of the Finance domain, and Life & Pensions in particular would be desirable. Experience in people management is an advantage, although training will be given to the right candidate. This is a fantastic opportunity to gain hands-on experience in software testing and develop your leadership, technical and analytical skills.

Our client seeks a Transaction Management Unit Manager to join their team. Role Profile: To independently implement and manage a range of complex Structured Corporate Loan transactions as intended by the loan agreement, in support of the IB business and Wholesale Clients clients. Key Responsibilities: Actively monitor, identify, investigate, resolve and / or escalate complex issues relating to the deal throughout the life of each live transaction and regularly communicate with stakeholders in order to maintain appropriate positions and efficient operations, ensure the transaction terms and conditions are adhered to by the client and / or third parties, provide a high-quality service, and mitigate operational risk. Collect and lodge all transaction collateral documentation (e.g. legal agreements, security agreements, share certificates) with the Collateral team for safe keeping and feed downstream calculations for capital management and credit risk mitigation. Coordinate with Legal, Credit and Collateral to approve and authorise various collateral (security) releases. Consult stakeholders, provide relevant operational expertise regarding complex Structured Loan transaction operational requirements into cross-functional enablement teams, provide approvals and participate in post product deployment reviews, to ensure the effective operation of new product development and smooth activations. Coordinate and inform stakeholders of the transaction close out when it reaches maturity, to ensure stakeholders are aligned, Wholesale Clients records are reliable and valid, and the capital management process is well supported. Where applicable, provide instructions to release all required collateral. Create complex transactions based on the salient features from the legal agreement to create an accounting record, enable the ongoing administration, monitoring and management of the facility and to facilitate ongoing reporting requirements. Key Skills and Experience: Educated to Degree Level (Business Commerce). 5 - 7 years experience in Operations. A track record adding value and delivering professional, client centric service to internal and /or external clients preferred. Experience working within Transaction Management in Financial Services supporting the Investment Banking business.
 If you have the required skills please apply online at searchandselect.com quoting reference number: 16599

We are looking for a results focused Manager to join our Restructuring Advisory team at FRP Advisory (Isle of Man) Ltd. You will work on a wide range of assignments across both advisory and formal engagements. You will take a lead role in managing a portfolio of insolvency cases, including, liquidations, receiverships, CVL’s and MVL’s ensuring statutory compliance whilst being responsible for stakeholder engagement throughout.

You will manage a portfolio of insolvency cases, overseeing case progression from appointment through to closure while ensuring compliance with relevant insolvency legislation. The role requires the ability to manage multiple priorities and lead teams across concurrent projects, delegating work effectively, reviewing outputs, and providing technical guidance where required. You will liaise with a range of stakeholders including directors, creditors, legal advisors, accountants and agents, undertake investigations into financial and legal matters, and prepare high-quality reports and presentations for both internal and external audiences. In addition, you will support the development of team members, contribute to training initiatives, process improvements and technical updates, and apply strong analytical, problem-solving and commercial skills to identify risks, develop practical solutions and recognise opportunities to support client needs and business growth. A balance of strategic thinking, attention to detail and strong leadership capability will be essential for success in the role.

Copilot said:

We are looking for a degree-educated professional who holds a recognised accounting qualification such as ACA, ACCA or ICAS, and has demonstrable experience managing insolvency and advisory cases. The successful candidate will possess strong technical knowledge of insolvency legislation and procedures, coupled with excellent report-writing and communication skills. They will be commercially aware, able to identify opportunities and understand client needs, while also being capable of managing competing priorities and delivering high-quality work in a fast-paced environment. A proactive, analytical approach and the ability to exercise sound judgement under pressure are essential.

You can apply to the role using this link: https://smrtr.io/zZV-x

Notes
As a Product Marketing Administrator, you'll help ensure IFGL's products and marketing materials remain accurate, up to date, and compliant with regulatory requirements. From maintaining product literature and supporting digital platforms to assisting with training initiatives and sales materials, you'll gain exposure to a wide range of product marketing activities.  This is a fantastic opportunity to take your first step into financial services, build a strong understanding of financial products, develop valuable technical and analytical skills, and collaborate with teams across the business.

The main duties for this role are:

Maintenance of the product literature suite ensuring timely and accurate updates where required.
Ensure the update of time-sensitive sales material including quarterly charge updates and time-limited special offers.
Support the development of the customer and adviser facing websites and internal gateway where product information is shown or stored.
Support regulatory updates or changes affecting products and literature.
Provide regular testing of illustration engines where product changes or charge information updates are required or occur.
Support and drive the development of the IFGL product training solution.
Provide support to stakeholders where product queries are received.
Monitor website traffic and prepare analytical reports to identify any required improvements or maintenance of hosted literature.

To ensure that this role is carried out to the desired level, the successful candidate should have the following skills and experience:

Have an interest in marketing and/or experience in the financial services industry.
Holds a minimum of 5 GCSEs A*-C including Maths and English.
Be proficient in Microsoft Office.
Possess strong organisational and planning skills.
Have excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Have an excellent level of numeracy. 
Be a confident and dedicated self-starter.
Have an excellent eye for detail due to the demands for maintaining product literature.

If you or you know someone who is interested in applying for this position, please forward a current CV with a covering letter to careers@ifg-ltd.com.

We encourage and welcome applications from people with diverse backgrounds because we embrace diversity and inclusivity within our business.

Closing date for this vacancy will be 12 August 2026.

Notes
Our Isle of Man office is looking for an individual with strong interpersonal skills who enjoys variety in their working day, to join us as Receptionist & Facilities Support on a full-time, permanent basis to assist the current team. 

This is a dual role, working predominantly on our Reception Desk but providing facilities support as and when required in a flexible capacity. 

Due to local immigration restrictions, we are only able to consider candidates who are local Manx residents

As Receptionist, you will be required to:

Operate the office switchboard 
Provide reception ‘meeting and greeting’ services to clients and office visitors
Organise client meeting room booking requests and prepare rooms for meetings
Provide routine office administration to assist the wider business
Book taxis and local accommodation for staff
Liaise with external office services e.g. couriers and receive small deliveries from suppliers or clients
Manage the office equipment loan stock for staff, for example portable printers and scanners
Logging and following up on Helpdesk tickets

Our Receptionist is the main contact point for our business and will be dealing with clients and suppliers and liaising with our staff. You will be dealing with a wide variety of activities, ranging from managing the reception desk and switchboard to organising meeting rooms, co-ordinating taxi bookings and assisting with administrative tasks.

In providing Facilities support, you will be required to assist with:

Replenishing and maintaining the kitchen areas on each floor, and vending machine in Staff Room
Collecting and distributing fruit and milk deliveries
Monitoring shredding bins on each floor and arranging collection
Maintaining photocopier and stationary areas on each floor – distributing supplies and consumables
Maintaining oversight and ensuring appropriate stock levels for vending machines and water towers
Liaising with third-party suppliers relating to PPM, Air Conditioning, ad-hoc R&M requirements and cleaning contracts
Ordering Supplies for the kitchens, vending machines, printers and stationary

Candidates do not need to have prior office experience to succeed in this role, however they should have strong communication skills and a proactive approach to working. 

Working hours are 08:45am - 5pm Monday to Friday 

To thrive in this role, you will also need:

Logical approach to task management 
Strong interpersonal skills 
Self-motivation and ability to use own initiative 
Readiness to work flexibly outside of core business hours (9am - 5:15pm) to support office based events, as required 
Intermediate knowledge of the Microsoft Office suite of programmes, with emphasis on Outlook
Language requirements - strong spoken, listening and written English
Previous experience in office facilities would be advantageous although not essential
Previous experience working on a Reception Desk within the financial services industry is preferable but not mandatory

To apply for this role please email Khamon@kpmg.com or call 01534608403

Notes
Not sure what “trust and corporate services” even means yet? That’s fine – most of our best people at Sentient International didn’t either when they started.

This is a genuine first-step career opportunity, not just a job. No experience, no jargon knowledge, no problem – we’ll teach you everything from the ground up.

The role

You’ll join our Client Services team and start learning the ropes of company and trust administration – real client work from day one, with someone experienced showing you how it’s done every step of the way.

It’s varied, it’s hands-on, and there’s always someone to ask if you’re not sure.

You’ll be involved in things like:

Helping set up and maintain company and trust structures for clients.
Preparing and maintaining company and trust records and documentation.
Preparing minutes and resolutions.
Preparing and filing statutory returns.
Working with our Compliance team on client due diligence.
Talking to clients and answering their queries.
Getting stuck into general office and admin tasks as part of the team.
What we’re looking for
You don’t need a background in finance or law – we’re far more interested in your attitude and potential than your CV.

We’re looking for someone who:

Is organised and good at managing their time.
Pays close attention to detail and gets things right.
Communicates clearly, in writing and in person.
Is keen to learn and not afraid to ask questions.
Works well with others and pulls their weight as part of a team.

No previous industry experience is required – full training and ongoing support is built into the role from day one.

For more details and to apply contact iom@sentientinternational.com
